 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 02, 2026, 21:01:17 IST SUMMARY India vs Korea Hockey Highlights, ACT 2026: India will look to carry their winning momentum into their final league-stage fixture of the Asian Champions Trophy 2026 when they take on South Korea on Monday. The hosts head into the contest on the back of a 4-2 victory over Malaysia, where captain Harmanpreet Singh stole the show with a brilliant hat-trick. 
 Harmanpreet scored in the third, 33rd and 58th minutes, converting two penalty corners and a penalty stroke. Sukhjeet Singh also got on the scoresheet in the 43rd minute, while Akhimullah Anuar and Shello Silverius scored for Malaysia. 
 The victory marked India's fourth consecutive win in the tournament and strengthened their position at the top of the standings. They have collected 12 points from four matches, with an impressive goal difference of +21. Harmanpreet, meanwhile, leads the tournament's scoring charts with eight goals. 
 South Korea, who have also secured a semi-final berth, will provide India's final test in the league stage before the knockout rounds. With the home crowd firmly behind them, the hosts will look to maintain their unbeaten run and build further momentum. 
 India captain Harmanpreet has made the team's ambitions clear: “We are here for gold…Our only target is to win at home…All the youngsters coming in are doing well.” 
 Follow our live blog for all the updates, goals, key moments, and action from India vs South Korea. Live Events 
 21:00 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: It's all over! IND 8-0 KOR India seal a thumping 8-0 victory over South Korea and maintain their clean sheet!
 There was late drama before the final hooter, with Korea earning a penalty corner. India opted for a referral, but the decision stood. Korea failed to convert, earning another penalty corner moments later, but wasted that opportunity too.
 India hold firm at the back and finish the contest without conceding a goal. A dominant attacking display, a rock-solid defence and a clean sheet for the Men in Blue.
 India 8-0 South Korea. What a statement victory!
 20:57 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: And India have eight! Angad Bir Singh joins the goal fest, finding his name on the scoresheet in the dying minutes of the match. India are now cruising to a massive 8-0 victory over South Korea. 
 The Men in Blue have been relentless from start to finish, and there's no letting up even in the closing stages.
 20:41 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India are showing no signs of taking their foot off the pedal The Men in Blue continue to push forward, piling on the pressure and searching for more goals despite their commanding 7-0 lead. The hunger for more is clearly visible as we head into the final 10 minutes of the match. Join conversation

 20:37 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: End of the third quarter, and India have completely taken control of the contest End of the third quarter, and India have completely taken control of the contest. Four goals in the quarter have taken the scoreline to a commanding 7-0 against South Korea. Shilanand Lakra, Sukhjeet Singh, Sanjay and Dilpreet Singh have all found the net in a breathtaking attacking display.
 Just 15 minutes remain. India ar e cruising, but can they add a few more in the final quarter?
 20:30 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: No way to stop India And India have seven. Dilpreet Singh finds the back of the net, adding another goal to South Korea's misery. India are absolutely relentless, and the scoreboard now reads 7-0! The Indian attack just keeps coming, with South Korea struggling to contain the wave of pressure. What a performance from the Men in Blue. 20:24 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India make it six; Sanjay gets his name on the scoresheet India make it six. Sanjay gets his name on the scoresheet as India turn on the style with another beautifully crafted goal. 
 A well-orchestrated build-up, crisp passing and a clinical finish. India are now 6-0 up, and this is turning into a one-sided affair. The Indian attack is firing on all cylinders.

 20:19 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India make it 4-0! What a start to the second half! Shilanand Lakra pounces on the rebound and makes no mistake, finding the back of the net to extend India's lead.
 The pressure was building, and India have their reward! South Korea have another mountain to climb as India go four goals clear, with 12 minutes remaining in the third quarter.
 20:05 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India 3-0 at HT It's half-time in the contest! No goals in the second quarter, but certainly no shortage of action. India head into the break with a commanding 3-0 lead over South Korea.
 Plenty of intensity, end-to-end action and some crucial moments in that quarter. India will look to carry this momentum into the second half.
 We'll be back shortly with all the action from the second half!
 19:52 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Korea have upped their tempo in 2nd quarter India survive the scare! The video referral goes India's way, and they successfully retain their review. The umpire was checking for a possible foot infringement that could have resulted in a penalty corner for South Korea, but there's no foot!
 With 10 minutes remaining in the second quarter, India maintain their 3-0 advantage. A crucial decision goes India's way, and they continue to keep South Korea at bay.
 19:36 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: GOAL! Harmanpreet Singh delivers yet again; India end first quarter 3-0 India are making a statement! 3-0, and Harmanpreet Singh delivers yet again! Right on the cusp of the end of the first quarter, India win a penalty corner, and the skipper makes it count with a thunderous drag-flick! Absolutely unstoppable! What a strike, what a start for India! 19:34 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: GOAL! India lead 2-0; Jugraj Singh scores India lead 2-0. Jugraj Singh with a stunning finish, and Punjab is absolutely jumping! 
 What a moment! Surrounded by defenders, Jugraj somehow creates the space and unleashes a ferocious shot that leaves the goalkeeper with no chance.
 And what a pass from Vishnukant Singh down the left flank! Perfect timing, brilliant vision, and Jugraj makes no mistake.
 19:27 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: GOAL! Dilpreet breaks the deadlock India draw first blood in the seventh minute of the match! Dilpreet Singh finds the back of the net with a fine backhand finish after Jarmanpreet Singh makes a superb run down the flank and sends in a centre. A well-worked move from the hosts as they take the lead against South Korea. 19:23 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India start on the front foot Almost half of the opening quarter is over, and India look the sharper side so far. The hosts are controlling possession, dictating the tempo and putting South Korea under pressure. India are moving the ball well and looking more purposeful going forward as they search for an early breakthrough. 19:17 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Action Begins in Jalandhar The match is underway in Jalandhar as India take on South Korea in their final league-stage fixture of the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. 
 This also marks the last match of the tournament at the Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium before the action shifts to Mohali for the next phase. The hosts look to sign off from Jalandhar on a winning note!
 19:14 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: National anthems underway South Korea's national anthem plays first, followed by India's national anthem as both teams stand in line ahead of the match. 19:05 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: South Korea Look to Challenge Unbeaten Indian Hosts South Korea will be looking to make their presence felt when they take on India in the final league-stage match of the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. 
 The Koreans have already qualified for the semi-finals with six points and will view this fixture as an opportunity to test themselves against the tournament leaders. India have been particularly strong in attack, but South Korea will hope to exploit any defensive gaps and put pressure on the hosts. 
 With both teams assured of a place in the last four, the contest could also provide valuable insights into their respective strengths and weaknesses ahead of the knockout stage.
 18:55 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Hosts Have Their Eyes Firmly on the Asian Champions Trophy Title India entered the Asian Champions Trophy 2026 with the ambition of winning the competition on home soil, and their performances so far have put them in a strong position. Four consecutive victories have taken the hosts to 12 points, while their goal difference of +21 reflects their dominance in the league stage. 
 Captain Harmanpreet Singh has led from the front, supported by important contributions from the younger members of the squad. India have already secured a semi-final place, but their focus will remain on maintaining consistency. 
 A strong performance against South Korea would provide another confidence boost before the tournament enters its decisive knockout phase.
 18:50 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: What India's 4-2 Win Over Malaysia Revealed India's previous encounter against Malaysia offered an interesting test ahead of their final league-stage match. Despite taking an early lead through Harmanpreet Singh, the hosts were pegged back when Akhimullah Anuar converted a penalty corner in the 25th minute. India had to work hard to regain control, with Harmanpreet scoring again in the third quarter before Sukhjeet Singh extended the advantage. 
 The Indian captain eventually completed his hat-trick through a penalty stroke. Malaysia also managed to find the net in the final minute. 
 The match showed India's attacking strength but also highlighted areas where the hosts will want to remain more alert defensively against South Korea.
 18:40 (IST) Nov 02 ndia vs South Korea Hockey Live: Here Is India's Starting XI — TheHockeyIndia (@TheHockeyIndia) 18:40 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Hardik Singh's Creativity Key to India's Midfield Hardik Singh continues to be an important presence in India's midfield, combining defensive responsibility with attacking creativity. His ability to carry the ball forward, find spaces and create opportunities has helped India maintain their attacking momentum throughout the tournament. 
 Against Malaysia, Hardik produced an incisive pass that allowed Sukhjeet Singh to score India's third goal in the 43rd minute. His contribution highlighted the importance of India's midfield in connecting defence with attack. Against South Korea, Hardik's distribution and movement could once again prove crucial. 
 India will look to control possession, dictate the tempo and create openings through their experienced midfielders.
 18:35 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: Sukhjeet Singh Adds Another Dimension to India's Attack Sukhjeet Singh has been an important part of India's attacking setup at the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. The forward found the net in the 43rd minute against Malaysia, extending India's lead to 3-1 with an excellent backhand finish. The goal came after a well-timed pass from Hardik Singh and highlighted the understanding within India's attacking unit. 
 While Harmanpreet Singh has dominated the headlines with eight goals, contributions from players like Sukhjeet have ensured that India have multiple attacking options. 
 As the hosts prepare to face South Korea, Sukhjeet will be keen to continue his good form and make another impact in the final league-stage fixture.
 18:30 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Can Indian Defence Deliver Another Strong Show? While India's attacking performances have attracted plenty of attention, their defensive organisation has also played an important role in their unbeaten campaign. Goalkeeper Krishan Bahadur Pathak has produced important saves, while defenders Amit Rohidas and Rajinder have stepped up during crucial moments. 
 Against Malaysia, the Indian defence came under pressure during the second quarter but managed to prevent the visitors from taking control. Pathak and Rohidas were particularly important in dealing with penalty-corner situations. 
 South Korea will look to test India's defensive structure with quick attacks and circle entries. The hosts will need another disciplined performance at the back to maintain their winning record.
 18:25 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: Harmanpreet's Drag-Flicks Remain India's Biggest Weapon Penalty corners have once again proved to be a major weapon for India in the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. Captain Harmanpreet Singh has been particularly effective, using his powerful drag-flicks to trouble opposition goalkeepers. Against Malaysia, he converted two penalty corners before completing his hat-trick through a penalty stroke. 
 His eight goals have taken him to the top of the tournament's scoring charts. India will be keen to earn more penalty-corner opportunities against South Korea, knowing how effectively their captain can convert them. The Korean defence will have to be alert and avoid conceding unnecessary fouls around the circle if they hope to contain India's set-piece threat.
 18:19 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: India's Attacking Unit Looks to Deliver Again India's attacking unit has been firing on all cylinders at the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. The hosts have scored freely throughout the league stage, with Harmanpreet Singh leading the charge through his penalty-corner expertise. 
 Sukhjeet Singh has also made valuable contributions, including a goal in the 4-2 victory over Malaysia. Hardik Singh's ability to create opportunities and link up play has further strengthened India's attacking options. 
 With the semi-finals approaching, the match against South Korea offers another opportunity for the Indian forwards to sharpen their combinations and build confidence. The hosts will hope their attacking rhythm continues as they chase the title on home soil.
 18:09 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Jalandhar Crowd Set to Cheer Hosts Again The Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar has been buzzing with excitement as India continue their impressive campaign at the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. The home crowd has played an important role in creating an energetic atmosphere, backing Harmanpreet Singh and his teammates throughout their matches. 
 After India's convincing 4-2 win over Malaysia, the supporters will be hoping for another strong performance against South Korea. 
 Harmanpreet himself acknowledged the impact of the fans, saying, “The energy from the crowd is infectious. Keep supporting us. Thank you, everyone.” With the hosts chasing the title on home soil, the Jalandhar crowd will once again be behind the team.
 18:09 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: India Lead Standings as Four Teams Qualify for Semis The semi-final line-up of the Asian Champions Trophy 2026 is taking shape, with India, Malaysia, Japan and South Korea having secured qualification for the last four. India currently lead the standings with 12 points from four matches and a goal difference of +21. 
 Malaysia are second with nine points, followed by Japan with seven and South Korea with six. China and Bangladesh have been eliminated from the title race. While qualification is already assured, India's final league-stage fixture against South Korea remains important for their position in the standings and preparations for the semi-finals. 
 The hosts will hope to finish the group stage on a winning note.
 18:08 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Can Korea Stop India's Winning Momentum? South Korea will provide India's final league-stage challenge in the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. The Koreans have collected six points from their four matches and have already secured qualification for the semi-finals. 
 However, facing an unbeaten Indian side in front of a passionate home crowd will be a different challenge altogether. India have looked particularly dangerous in attack, scoring freely while maintaining an impressive goal difference of +21. 
 South Korea will need to remain disciplined defensively and make the most of their attacking opportunities if they are to trouble the hosts. The contest will also offer both teams an opportunity to build confidence before the knockout rounds.
 18:08 (IST) Nov 02 IND vs KOR Hockey Live Score: Harmanpreet Singh Leads Tournament Scoring Charts Indian captain Harmanpreet Singh has been one of the standout performers in the Asian Champions Trophy 2026. The drag-flick specialist has already scored eight goals and currently leads the tournament's scoring charts. 
 His latest contribution was a sensational hat-trick against Malaysia, where he converted two penalty corners and a penalty stroke to guide India to a 4-2 victory. Harmanpreet's consistency in front of goal has been crucial to India's unbeaten campaign, particularly with his ability to convert penalty-corner opportunities. 
 South Korea will need to keep a close watch on the Indian skipper, who will once again be central to the hosts' attacking plans.
 18:07 (IST) Nov 02 India vs South Korea Hockey Live: Harmanpreet Singh and Co Eye Fifth Straight Win India have been in outstanding form at the Asian Champions Trophy 2026, winning all four of their matches so far. Harmanpreet Singh and Co. have collected 12 points and sit comfortably at the top of the standings with an impressive goal difference of +21. 
 Their latest victory came against Malaysia, where the Indian captain scored a brilliant hat-trick to inspire a 4-2 win. Having already secured a place in the semi-finals, India will now look to maintain their unbeaten record and carry their momentum into the knockout stage. 
 A victory against South Korea would give the hosts a perfect five wins from five league matches.
 India vs Korea Hockey Highlights, ACT 2026: India are set to face South Korea in their final league-stage fixture of the Asian Champions Trophy 2026 on Monday, looking to extend their unbeaten run and maintain their winning momentum ahead of the semi-finals. The hosts come into the contest after an impressive 4-2 victory over Malaysia, with captain Harmanpreet Singh producing a match-winning hat-trick.
Playing at the Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar, Harmanpreet opened the scoring in the third minute with a penalty-corner conversion. Malaysia responded through Akhimullah Anuar in the 25th minute, but the Indian skipper restored the lead in the 33rd minute with another penalty-corner goal.
India took control in the second half, with Sukhjeet Singh extending the advantage in the 43rd minute after receiving a fine pass from Hardik Singh. Harmanpreet then completed his hat-trick in the 58th minute by converting a penalty stroke. Malaysia managed a late consolation goal through Shello Silverius, but India held on for a 4-2 win.
The victory was India's fourth in as many matches, taking their tally to 12 points and keeping them at the top of the standings with a goal difference of +21. Malaysia are second with nine points, followed by Japan with seven and South Korea with six. All four teams have already booked their places in the semi-finals.
Harmanpreet has been India's standout performer in front of goal and currently leads the tournament's scoring charts with eight goals. After the Malaysia victory, the Indian captain reiterated the team's ambition to win the title on home soil.
“We are here for gold…Our only target is to win at home…All the youngsters coming in are doing well,” he said.
India will now look to finish the league stage on a high against South Korea before turning their attention to the knockout rounds. With the home crowd providing strong support in Jalandhar, the hosts will aim to continue their dominant run.
